armor.line: I am shielded in my armor
stanza: I have my books
And my poetry to protect me
I am shielded in my armor
Hiding in my room
Safe within my womb
I touch no one and no one touches me

armor.line: When they know they're your heart and you know you are their armor
armor.linePrev: Not the expression, no, literally give an arm for
armor.lineNext: And you will destroy anyone who would try to harm her

stanza: Your daddy was a farmer
His back was burnished red and gold
And every time he closed his eyes a rooster crowed
He sowed a hundred rows of corn
The summer you were born
And wondered what your life would yield

farmer.line: With the flatlands and the farmer
stanza: He never seemed to find a place
With the flatlands and the farmer
So he had to leave one day
He said to be an actor

warmer.songTitle: The Predatory Wasp of the Palisades Is Out to Get Us!
warmer.line: Wearing three layers of coats and leg warmers
stanza: Thinking outrageously I write in cursive
I hide in my bed with the lights on the floor
Wearing three layers of coats and leg warmers
I see my own breath on the face of the door
